'''Ava's mother''' is a supporting character in ''[[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]]''.
==History==
[[File:Ava mom child.png|250px|left|thumb|Ava's mother as a child]]
===Pre-series===
In the past, Ava's mother was a professional [[Pokémon TCG]] player, but over time she stopped playing after losing an important match in the [[World Championships]].
===''[[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]]''===
In ''[[PTP01|The Club]]'', Ava's mother and the rest of her family moved to a new town, during the days that passed, she was seen working and organizing things in the new house.

In ''[[PTP02|Regionals]]'', she was seen wishing Ava good luck at the regional competition and delivering some groceries, when she intended to tell Ava a secret she was interrupted and just said goodbye to her.

In ''[[PTP03|Internationals]]'', Ava's mother was seen helping her daughter prepare for another championship. During the finals against [[Edgar Troy]], she was seen watching the match while working, in the climax of the battle, she was able to understand his strategy before Ava even realized it.

In ''[[PTP04|Worlds]]'', seeing her daughter depressed by the loss in the previous tournament, she told Ava about her past as a professional player and how the defeat affected her. When Ava decided to go to the World Championships, she and her husband were together cheering Ava from the stands. During the rematch against Edgar Troy and seeing that Ava was having fun, she explained to [[Joshua]] what Ava was feeling and finally celebrated Ava's victory with her husband and her daughter's friends.

==Character==
In contrast to her [[Ava's father|husband]], Ava's mother is more serious and focused on her work, but has shown enormous concern for her daughter's well-being.
